description: OmpDeck device protocol v1 vectors, generated by deck_remote::noise (see README.md). Device = initiator, gateway = responder. Transport frames alternate per the `from` side; both sessions use rekey_messages = 3. Frames above 4096 bytes are given by len + sha256 only. `rejected_handshakes`: with the keys and ephemerals above, the gateway refuses `msg1`, or the device (after sending the vector msg1 of `mode`) refuses `msg2`, or refuses to start against `gateway_public`, with `error`. `rejected_frames`: a fresh reconnect session (`max_message` overriding the reassembly cap) of `receiver` opens every frame but the last, which fails with `error` and poisons the session.

rejected_frames.case: device frame reflected to the device
gateway frame reflected to the gateway
